title: automation_plan_generator
description: Handoff contract emitted by sdet-plan-generator (EMIT_AUTOMATION_PLAN mode) for the downstream Test-Data-Generation stage defined in the Backend QA Test-Data Generation RFC. Mirrors that RFC's automation-plan-generator INPUT shape (pre-enrichment — the test-data stage later adds test_data_output). The RFC owns the canonical contract, so this schema is intentionally permissive (additionalProperties allowed) and pins only the fields the emission must always carry.

epic_id.description: From feature_metadata (the EPIC/Jira id if present, else the feature_key).

generated_from.description: Source SDET plan filename this was emitted from, e.g. 'birthday_reward_SDET_plan.json'. Provenance for re-generation.

emit_notes.description: Open points from the emission itself — most commonly a backend field the mobile SDET plan could not supply. Same spirit as extraction_notes: never fabricated, always surfaced.

automation_scenarios.description: Only scenarios whose (post-sync) Execution Mode is Automatable. Manual scenarios stay in the SDET plan and are excluded here.

scenario_id.description: Stable id (e.g. SC-001), assigned in scenario order. Reused on re-generation so downstream references stay valid.

target_framework.description: The scenario's target_execution_framework, verbatim (e.g. TAPMIND_NLP, GMT_JAVA). Backend consumers may map to their own value.

service_name.description: Backend-only. Present only when the SDET plan actually carries it; omitted (with an emit_note) otherwise. Never fabricated.

test_data.description: The identification INPUT for the test-data stage. Carried directly from the SDET scenario's test_data[] — fixture_id, description, and required_state. The test-data stage appends test_data_output; do not add it here.

required_state.description: Static entity attributes, verbatim from the SDET fixture. Carried as-is — never re-derived here.

dynamic_conditions.description: Carried through from the SDET fixture — temporal/relational/selection needs that are not static attributes.
